name: Monte Serra Short Loop
description: The direct route to Tuscany's test climb: 53 km from Lucca up Monte Serra and back. The benchmark effort of every pro who has lived here.

name: Monte Serra Loop
description: The standard Monte Serra circuit: 70 km from Lucca over the climb with the full descent and valley return.

name: Monte Serra Extended Loop
description: The long way round: 94 km and over 1,700 m taking in Monte Serra and the surrounding hills — a proper Tuscan training day.

name: Pizzorne from Villa Basilica
description: Lucca's plateau climb: 57 km with the switchback ascent of the Pizzorne from Villa Basilica — 1,300 m of climbing straight out of the plain.

name: Lucca to Pisa Easy Loop
description: 48 km of flat valley riding from Lucca's walls to Pisa and back — the classic recovery spin with a leaning tower halfway.

name: Lucca to Viareggio Easy Loop
description: 73 km out to the coast at Viareggio and back across the plain — flat tempo riding with a seafront espresso at the turn.

name: Montecarlo Vineyards Loop
description: 66 km through the rolling vineyard hills east of Lucca via the walled village of Montecarlo — punchy climbs and Tuscan postcard views.

name: Garfagnana and Abetone Epic
description: The Apennine monster: 148 km and over 3,200 m through the Garfagnana valley to Castelnuovo and the Abetone climbs. A full day in the high mountains.
